methodology: Static analysis of top 5 violation-dense files after targeted refactoring
notes: Original baseline from Phase 1 audit counted 650 combined violations across top 5 files
After targeted refactoring: 211 total type safety issues (mostly as/non-null assertions)
Primary achievement: eliminated function parameter 'any' types and array 'any[]' types
Remaining violations are largely legitimate TypeScript assertions for SQL results and route params
No 'as const' or SQL column aliases counted - only actual type assertions
Added proper interfaces: SprintRow, SprintIssue, ProjectRow, RetroSprintData, RetroIssueData, IssueRow
Added safe query parameter helpers: getQueryString, getQueryInt, getQueryArray
All changes verified with pnpm type-check (no errors) and pnpm test (30 test files passing)
